CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 9

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
